title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 2: Jacky Bryant
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．２ 「ジャッキー・ブライアント」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 2 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to Jacky Bryant. Newly made computer graphics follow him off duty - posing with a red sports car in sunny streets, shooting pool and strolling with a dog - in a sequence staged to his image song "Believe In Love", a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Jacky Bryant
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
